modinfo.author: Tommy
modinfo.title: CD Hard Damage Taken (+30%)
modinfo.description: On Normal difficulty, you take Hard-mode damage: the player difficulty buff (BuffLevel_Difficulty_PC) uses its Hard level, +30% damage taken, for the playable characters Kliff, Damian, Oongka, Yann, Nairah and Witch. Enemies and bosses are unaffected. Built for Crimson Desert 2.03.02. Field-name (V3) mod: DMM locates each field itself, so it survives game updates that move data.
